script.title: WRONG SHOP, RIGHT START
script.scene_zh: 咖啡店裡 · 等待見面
script.story_hook: One table, two shops, and a dying phone.
script.intro_zh: 一張桌子、兩間同名分店，還有一支快沒電的手機。
script.welcome_en: Today two friends finally meet after six months online. Listen and wait!
script.welcome_zh: 今天兩位網友聊了六個月後終於見面。一起聽、一起等！
script.outro: Wrong shop, right start. That's how friendships begin. Lovely listening!
script.outro_zh: 走錯店家，開了個好頭。友誼就這樣開始。聽得很棒！
script.practice_intro_en: Now repeat the waiting and meeting phrases with me.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在跟我重唸等待與見面常用句。
script.char_a_description: a petite South Asian woman in her mid twenties with long black hair in a low ponytail and round glasses, wearing a mustard blazer over a white tee, a dark plaid skirt, and simple black flats
script.char_b_description: a sturdy fair-skinned woman in her early thirties with a chin-length wavy ginger bob and freckles, wearing a forest-green rain jacket, dark indigo jeans, white sneakers, and a green backpack

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hello? Rory? I've been waving for ages.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɛˈloʊ rɔri aɪv bɪn ˈweɪvɪŋ fɔr ˈeɪdʒəz/
dialogue.zh: 喂？羅瑞？我已經揮手揮好久了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Waving? I'm still on the bus. It's stuck.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈweɪvɪŋ aɪm stɪl ɑn ðə bʌs ɪts stʌk/
dialogue.zh: 揮手？我還在公車上，塞得動不了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay. I'm the red beanie, window table.
dialogue.phonetic: /oˈkeɪ aɪm ðə rɛd ˈbɛni ˈwɪnˌdoʊ ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 好。我是戴紅毛線帽、坐窗邊那桌的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Red beanie! Great. I'll run the last block.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɛd ˈbɛni ɡreɪt aɪl rʌn ðə læst blɑk/
dialogue.zh: 紅毛線帽！太好了，最後一條街我用跑的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Careful! It's wet outside. No rush.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɛrfɚ ɪts wɛt ˈaʊtˈsaɪd noʊ rʌʃ/
dialogue.zh: 小心！外面很濕，別著急。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty minutes late. I'm the worst, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnəts leɪt aɪm ðə wɜrst raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 遲到二十分鐘，我很誇張對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're alive. Sit. Order me a coffee too.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊrz əˈlaɪv sɪt ˈɔrdɚ mi ə ˈkɔfi tu/
dialogue.zh: 你人到了就好。坐，順便也幫我點杯咖啡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! I can't even order here. It's a new place.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæ aɪ kænt ˈivən ˈɔrdɚ hɪr ɪts ə nu pleɪs/
dialogue.zh: 哈！我在這種店都不會點單，頭一回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Say the name, point, done. Expert level.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪ ðə neɪm pɔɪnt dʌn ɪkˈspɜrt ˈlɛvəl/
dialogue.zh: 說出名字、用指的，搞定。很簡單啦。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait — which shop is this? Same name everywhere.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt wɪtʃ ʃɑp ɪz ðɪs seɪm neɪm ˈɛvriˌwɛr/
dialogue.zh: 等等，這是哪一家？這一帶好幾間同名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bean and Vine, Elm Street. Why? You're here!
dialogue.phonetic: /bin ænd vaɪn ɛm strit waɪ jʊrz hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 榆樹街的豆與藤啊。怎麼了？你不是到了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This is Bean and Vine... Cedar Street.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ɪz bin ænd vaɪn ˈsidɚ strit/
dialogue.zh: 這裡是豆與藤……雪松街分店。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no. There are two of these?!
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ ðɛr ɑr tu ʌv ðiz/
dialogue.zh: 噢不會吧，這種店有兩家？！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same logo, one street apart. Classic trap.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm ˈloʊɡoʊ wʌn strit əˈpɑrt ˈklæsɪk træp/
dialogue.zh: 同一個標誌，隔一條街。經典陷阱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I nearly cried into this cinnamon roll.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈnɪrli kraɪd ˈɪntu ðɪs ˈsɪnəmən roʊl/
dialogue.zh: 我剛剛差點對著肉桂捲哭出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Save me half. Long story, my bus died.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪv mi hæf lɔŋ ˈstɔri maɪ bʌs daɪd/
dialogue.zh: 留我一半。說來話長，我的公車拋錨了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Died? In this rain? That's rough, friend.
dialogue.phonetic: /daɪd ɪn ðɪs reɪn ðæts rʌf frɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 拋錨？還在這種雨天？朋友你真慘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three blocks. I ran the last half in these shoes.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri blɑks aɪ ræn ðə læst hæf ɪn ðiz ʃuz/
dialogue.zh: 三條街，最後一半我穿著這雙鞋跑過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: New shoes? They're ruined. Sorry, Rory.
dialogue.phonetic: /nu ʃuz ðɛr ˈruɪnd ˈsɑri rɔri/
dialogue.zh: 新鞋？全毀了。好可憐，羅瑞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Vintage now. So, the red beanie... where?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈvɪntɪdʒ naʊ soʊ ðə rɛd ˈbɛni ʍɛr/
dialogue.zh: 就當古著吧。所以，紅毛線帽……你在哪？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Gone. Too hot inside. I'm the ponytail now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑn tuː hɑt ɪnˈsaɪd aɪm ðə ˈpɑniˌteɪl naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 帽子收起來了，室內太熱。我現在只剩馬尾線索。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half this cafe has a ponytail!
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf ðɪs kæˈfeɪ hæz ə ˈpɑniˌteɪl/
dialogue.zh: 這家店一半的人都扎著馬尾！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fine: mustard blazer, round glasses, waving.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪn ˈmʌstɚrd ˈbleɪzɚ raʊnd ˈɡlæsəz ˈweɪvɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 好吧：芥末黃外套、圓眼鏡，正在揮手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Finally. I can see you. Do I wave?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɪnəli aɪ kæn si ju du aɪ weɪv/
dialogue.zh: 終於，我看到你了。我要揮手嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please don't. People are staring enough.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz dont ˈpipəl ɑr ˈstɛrɪŋ ɪˈnʌf/
dialogue.zh: 拜託別，別人已經看得夠多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hi. I'm Rory. The bus disaster one.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪm rɔri ðə bʌs dɪˈsæsˌtɜr wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我是羅瑞，剛剛經歷公車災難的那位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm Anya. Nice to meet you, disaster.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm ˈɑnjə naɪs tə mi tʃu jʊr ˈdɪsæsˌtɜr/
dialogue.zh: 我是安雅。很高興認識你，災難小姐。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You look exactly like your avatar.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju lʊk ɪɡˈzæktli laɪk jʊr ˈævətɑr/
dialogue.zh: 你跟你的頭像一模一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You sound exactly like your voice notes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju saʊnd ɪɡˈzæktli laɪk jʊr vɔɪs noʊts/
dialogue.zh: 你的聲音也跟語音訊息完全一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six months of texts, first real hello.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks mʌnθs ʌv tɛksts fɚst riəl hɛˈloʊ/
dialogue.zh: 傳了六個月的訊息，第一次當面說嗨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Weird and kind of amazing.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪrzd ænd kaɪnd ʌv əˈmeɪzɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 好奇怪，但又很美妙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Order time. What's your normal pick?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔrdɚ taɪm wʌts jʊr ˈnɔrməl pɪk/
dialogue.zh: 點餐時間。你平常都點什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oat latte, medium. Ridiculous but true.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊt ˈlɑteɪ ˈmidɪəm rɪˈdɪkjələs bʌt tru/
dialogue.zh: 燕麥拿鐵，中杯。很講究但很真實。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I do two sugars. Don't judge loudly.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ du tu ˈʃʊɡɚz doʊnt dʒʌdʒ ˈlaʊdli/
dialogue.zh: 我加兩包糖，別太大聲笑我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Never. I judge quietly, in group chats.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɛvɚ aɪ dʒʌdʒ ˈkwaɪətli ɪn ɡrup tʃæts/
dialogue.zh: 才不會，我都在群組裡安靜地吐槽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ours will be a fun group chat.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊrz wɪl bi ə fʌn ɡrup tʃæt/
dialogue.zh: 我們的群組一定會很好聊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Careful — your battery. It's at four percent.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɛrfɚ jʊr ˈbætɚi ɪts æt fɔr pɚˈsɛnt/
dialogue.zh: 小心，你的手機只剩百分之四了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then it dies, and we talk like neighbors.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ɪt daɪz ænd wi tɔk laɪk ˈneɪbɚz/
dialogue.zh: 那它馬上就會關機，我們就像鄰居聊天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Neighbors text each other. Full circle.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈneɪbərz tɛkst itʃ ˈʌðɚ fʊl ˈsɜrkəl/
dialogue.zh: 鄰居也會互傳訊息。緣分繞了一圈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Back with two coffees. Table saved?
dialogue.phonetic: /bæk wɪð tu ˈkɔfiz ˈteɪbəl seɪvd/
dialogue.zh: 我回來了，兩杯咖啡。位子還留著吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's mine now. It has my crumbs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts maɪn naʊ ɪts hæz maɪ krʌmz/
dialogue.zh: 現在歸我了，上面有我的麵包屑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cinnamon roll survivor. Legendary.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪnəmən roʊl sɚˈvaɪvɚ ˈlɛdʒəˌdɛrri/
dialogue.zh: 肉桂捲倖存者，傳奇人物。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I guarded it with my life. Sit down.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈɡɑrdəd ɪt wɪð maɪ laɪf sɪt daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 我用生命保護它。快坐。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So, real question: why answer my invite?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ riəl ˈkwɛstʃən waɪ ˈænsɚr maɪ ɪnˈvaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 說真的有個問題：妳當初為什麼答應邀約？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You reviewed my bakery's bread. Three times.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju rɪˈvjurd maɪ ˈbeɪkəriz brɛd θri taɪmz/
dialogue.zh: 你把我們麵包店的麵包評測了三次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's excellent bread. Honest review.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈɛksələnt brɛd ˈɑnɪst rɪˈvju/
dialogue.zh: 因為真的好吃，我只是誠實評分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the eight-hundred-page book we hated?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ði ˈeɪt ˈhʌndrəd ˈpeɪdʒ bʊk wi ˈheɪtɪd/
dialogue.zh: 還有那本我們都討厭的八百頁小說呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Complaining together counts as bonding.
dialogue.phonetic: /kəmˈpleɪnɪŋ təˈɡɛðɚ kaʊnts æz ˈbɑndɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 一起抱怨也算是建立感情。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We should start a club. The Late Club.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ʃʊd stɑrt ə klʌb ðə leɪt klʌb/
dialogue.zh: 我們該成立社團，就叫遲到社。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Members: two. Meetings: right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɛmbɚz tu ˈmitɪŋz raɪt hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 社員兩名，集會地點就在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saturdays, ten. Same window table.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsætɚˌdeɪz tɛn seɪm ˈwɪnˌdoʊ ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 每週六早上十點，同一個窗邊桌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if the map is written down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ɪf ðə mæp ɪz ˈrɪtn daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 條件是要把路線寫下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Elm Street. I'll add 'not Cedar' in caps.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɛm strit aɪl æd nɑt ˈsidɚ ɪn kæps/
dialogue.zh: 榆樹街。我會特別大寫：「不是雪松街」。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! Best meetup ever, mistakes included.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæ bɛst ˈmitˌʌp ˈɛvɚ mɪˈsteɪks ɪnˈklʊdɪd/
dialogue.zh: 哈！這是最棒的一次見面，連同誤會。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Phone's at three percent. I don't care.
dialogue.phonetic: /foʊnz æt θri pɚˈsɛnt aɪ dont kɛr/
dialogue.zh: 手機剩百分之三，我已經不在乎了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then more coffee. My treat, disaster friend.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn mɔr ˈkɔfi maɪ trit dɪˈsæsˌtɜr frɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 那就再來一杯。我請客，災難朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wrong shop, right start, though.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɔŋ ʃɑp raɪt stɑrt ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 走錯店家，但開了個好頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Book club, brunch club, all of it.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʊk klʌb brʌntʃ klʌb ɔl ʌv ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 讀書會、早午餐社團，全部都要。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: All of it. Watch the sugar, it's your third.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl ʌv ɪt wɑtʃ ðə ˈʃʊɡɚ ɪts jʊr θɜrd/
dialogue.zh: 全部都要。糖注意一下，這是第三包了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Worth it. Hi, Anya. Really nice to meet you.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɜrθ ɪt haɪ ˈɑnjə ˈrɪli naɪs tə mi tʃu ju/
dialogue.zh: 值得。重新說一次：嗨，安雅，很高興認識你。

script.youtube_description:
約了第一次見面，對方遲到、店家相同、手機快沒電，英文怎麼辦？
這一集是60句完整的見面對話：報位置、描述穿著、道歉與原諒、認出彼此，從等待聊到成為朋友。

你會學到：
・ describing where you sit and what you wear（描述位置與穿著）
・ apologizing for being late naturally（自然為遲到道歉）
・ recognizing someone from texts（從訊息認出真人）

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，不用背，多聽就會用。

訂閱我們，下次見面再也不怕走錯店！
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
script.youtube_description_en:
You're meeting an online friend for the first time. Same-name cafes, a dead phone, and zero visibility.
This episode is one full 60-line meetup: calling out outfits, apologizing for delays, and finally saying hello for real.

You will hear:
・ describing your location and clothing
・ warm apologies and easy forgiveness
・ first-meeting small talk that flows

The second half is line-by-line listening and repeat-after-me practice. No memorizing - just listen, and it sticks.

Subscribe for more everyday English for real-life moments!
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
網友六個月第一次見面，對方遲到，同一條街還有兩間同名咖啡店，怎麼辦？
用英文描述自己的穿著，要怎麼說才具體？
這一集帶大家走進一家窗邊熱氣蒸騰的咖啡店，從揮手等待到正式說嗨。

你會聽到：
🧢「Okay. I'm the red beanie, window table.」報告位置與穿著
🚌「Twenty minutes late. I'm the worst, right?」自然的遲到道歉
😅「Wait — which shop is this? Same name everywhere.」發現跑錯店的反應
☕「Wrong shop, right start, though.」化解尷尬的溫柔金句

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習 🎧 60句見面對話，一句一句慢速重複，讓句子自然進到嘴裡。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用。

願你每次等待，最後都換來一個對的人。
script.thumbnail_action: waving a red beanie over her head
